text: dsh-restart-desktop 为 Windows 桌面版 DSH 的侧边栏添加完整重启按钮。它通过侧边栏操作槽显示按钮，并由 Host 路由启动独立助手，结束当前桌面应用后重新打开。功能包括检测是否支持、发起重启、显示处理中或失败状态，以及重启失败后重新开放操作。适合希望从 DSH 侧边栏直接重启 Windows 桌面应用的用户。需要 Windows 桌面版 DSH 和系统 PowerShell。

dsh-restart-desktop adds a sidebar restart button for Windows DSH desktop. A Host route starts a detached helper to stop and relaunch the app. The button shows status, and the helper retries failed launches and logs progress. Requires Windows DSH desktop and PowerShell.
想从 DSH 侧边栏直接重启 Windows 桌面应用。
DSH 桌面程序怎么完整退出再重新打开？
给桌面版 DSH 加一个侧边栏重启按钮。
希望重启应用时自动重新启动，不用手动再打开。
I want to restart the Windows DSH desktop app from its sidebar.
How can I fully quit and reopen the DSH desktop application?
dsh-restart-desktop 的「侧边栏重启」功能：在侧边栏底部注册重启按钮；仅当 Host 报告支持时显示。点击后发送重启请求，并展示处理中或失败状态。
dsh-restart-desktop 的「重新启动桌面应用」功能：Host 写入请求文件并启动分离的助手进程；助手等待请求响应离开后结束应用进程树，再启动相同可执行文件。
dsh-restart-desktop 的「启动失败重试」功能：助手在重新启动后检查应用是否运行，未检测到时再次启动，最多执行三轮检查，并将过程追加记录到日志。
希望在 Windows 桌面版里一键关闭并重新打开 DSH。
DSH 重启后没有自动打开时，能否自动再试几次？

One click fully quits the Electron application and opens it again — no tray menu, no terminal, no hunting for the window.

dsh-restart-desktop README · Features：- **One click, real restart.** The whole desktop app exits and starts again — the same thing as closing it from the tray and reopening it, but in one action.
- **Lives where you expect it.** A row in the sidebar footer, directly above **Settings**; in the collapsed 56px rail it becomes a round icon button.
- **Stays out of the way.** The button only renders when the Host reports that this is a Windows desktop app; in `dsh web` or on unsupported platforms it hides itself.
- **No shell windows.** The relauncher is a detached Node process and a hidden PowerShell child; nothing flashes on screen.
- **Evidence when it fails.** Every attempt appends to `%TEMP%\dsh-restart-desktop\restart.log`, and the launch is verified with a retry.
- **Localized.** English and Simplified Chinese UI text, display metadata for the plugin manager, and its own original icon.

dsh-restart-desktop README · Requirements：| | |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | Desktop build (Electron), `dsh >= 0.2.0-rc.1` |
| OS | Windows 10/11 |
| Node | 20+ (only for development) |

The plugin is a DSH **bundle**: a Host half plus a browser half. It is not an npm dependency of your project; it installs into a DSH profile.

dsh-restart-desktop README · From a local checkout：```bash
git clone https://github.com/StarMoon-win/dsh-restart-plugin.git
```

Then point the profile at the checkout:

```jsonc
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-restart-desktop": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-restart-plugin"
}
```

and add `"dsh-restart-desktop"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`, or install the directory through the plugin manager.
dsh-restart-desktop README · Uninstall：Remove `dsh-restart-desktop` from `dsh.profile.bundles` (and from `dependencies`), then restart the app.

dsh-restart-desktop README · Usage：1. Find **Restart** in the sidebar footer, above **Settings**.
   - Expanded sidebar: icon + `Restart` / `重启`.
   - Collapsed rail: a round icon button with a native tooltip.
2. Click it. The page shows `Restarting…`, the app exits after about a second, and a fresh instance opens.
3. **Running tasks are interrupted.** There is no confirmation dialog — the click is the confirmation.

If the button shows `Restart failed`, wait a few seconds and try again, then read the log:

dsh-restart-desktop README · Usage：```
%TEMP%\dsh-restart-desktop\restart.log
```

dsh-restart-desktop README · How it works：```
Sidebar button (client.js)
   │  GET  /dsh-restart-desktop/status    → render only when supported
   │  POST /dsh-restart-desktop/restart   → 202, then the page dies with the app
   ▼

dsh-restart-desktop README · Why force-terminate?：The desktop shell turns a window close into **hide to tray**, and quitting asks the Host whether tasks are active before showing a confirmation dialog. `app.asar` exposes no `app.quit()` / `app.relaunch()` channel to plugins — the only Host-facing control messages are `quit-inspection` and `update-tasks`, both initiated by the Electron main process.

dsh-restart-desktop README · Why force-terminate?：So the only way a plugin can produce a *complete* restart is to end the application tree from **outside** it and start the executable again. That is exactly what the detached helper does.

dsh-restart-desktop README · Development：```bash
git clone https://github.com/StarMoon-win/dsh-restart-plugin.git
cd dsh-restart-plugin

node --check index.js

`scripts/validate.mjs` checks the manifest exports, the locale files, the icon, and the patch file without activating the plugin.

dsh-restart-desktop README · Development：To exercise the relauncher without touching the app, point a request file at a harmless program (for example `notepad.exe`, image `notepad`, a 200 ms delay) and run `node helper.mjs <request.json>`; the log shows the stop, launch, and verification steps.

dsh-restart-desktop README · Reloading a linked checkout：A profile installed with `link:` points at your working tree. Host code is not hot-reloaded across that junction, so after editing `index.js` or `helper.mjs`:

1. disable and re-enable `dsh-restart-desktop` in Settings → Plugins (or via the plugin manager), or
2. restart the app with the new button.

The browser half (`client.js`) is picked up on the next page load.

dsh-restart-desktop README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Check |
| --- | --- |
| No button in the sidebar | Is the profile the desktop one and the bundle in `dsh.profile.bundles`? Open `/dsh-restart-desktop/status` on the app origin; `supported` must be `true`. |
| Button always says “Restart failed” | Read `%TEMP%\dsh-restart-desktop\restart.log`. A missing `launched pid=…` line means the helper could not start the executable. |
| Install fails with `timed out waiting for the writer lock` | A stale `package.json.lock` in the profile; restart the app so the recorded holder PID is gone, then install again. |
| App exits but does not reopen | The log ends with `FAILED: the application did not come back`. Start the app manually and report the log. |
